title: War-shattered charred Scots pine stump — Ukrainian/Russian front-line biome

sources.pinus_wiki: Pinus sylvestris — Wikipedia (trunk DBH range; bark description; two-tone bark)
sources.conifers_org: conifers.org — Pinus sylvestris species profile (lower bark thickness, colour and texture)
sources.eu_jrc: EU JRC Forest Atlas — Pinus sylvestris stand dimension tables
sources.research_trees: docs/2026-06-10-nature-research-trees.md — regionally sourced tree dimensions (Scots pine 0.5–1.3 m DBH, orange-red upper bark, lower bark up to 5 cm thick)
sources.war_forests: Reuters/VOA 'Ukraine's vast forests devastated'; Grist — front-line forest becomes 'a field of stumps', 'stripped, broken trunks — a moonscape of black sticks and charcoal piles, fully defoliated' (qualitative; no quantified stump/splinter dimensions)

trunk_dbh_mm.unit: mm (diameter at breast height, 1.3 m above ground)
trunk_dbh_mm.src: pinus_wiki, eu_jrc — range 500–1300 mm (exceptionally >1700 mm); lower end used for a medium-aged specimen
trunk_dbh_mm.note: Same tree species as stump_cut; using 500 mm DBH

trunk_r_mm.unit: mm (cross-section radius at the shatter face)

root_flare_r_mm.unit: mm (stump radius at soil level, including root-flare buttresses)
root_flare_r_mm.src: DESIGN — no quantified source found; set at trunk_r_mm × 1.24 (24% wider at base, same proportional estimate as stump_cut dossier)

root_flare_h_mm.unit: mm (visible height of root-flare zone above soil level)
root_flare_h_mm.src: DESIGN — no quantified source; set as ~15% of stump height for a visually readable proportion

soil_disc_r_mm.unit: mm (radius of char / disturbed-soil ground disc around the stump base)
soil_disc_r_mm.derivation: root_flare_r_mm + 50 = 310 + 50 = 360 mm — a thin visual base pad surrounding the root flare

stump_shatter_h_mm.unit: mm (height from ground to the war-shatter / break point)
stump_shatter_h_mm.src: DESIGN — war shatter height is not quantified in any source (research_trees explicitly flags 'no quantified residual snapped-trunk/stump height'); 650 mm chosen as a mid-range design value consistent with observed 'black sticks' imagery (~knee-to-waist height)

char_coverage.qualitative: Intensively shelled front-line forest becomes 'a field of stumps / stripped, broken trunks — a moonscape of black sticks and charcoal piles, fully defoliated'
char_coverage.model_treatment: Exterior: charBlack throughout (trunk, root flare, streak details, heartwood core at break). Exposed interior wood visible only at the shatter face.

break_face_th_mm.unit: mm (stand-proud thickness of each concentric wood-ring disc at the shatter face)
break_face_th_mm.src: DESIGN — geometric detail; 12 mm reads as a distinct face without excessive bulk at game scale
break_face_th_mm.note: Three stacked discs: outer sapwood (woodMid), latewood ring (woodDark), burned core (charBlack)

splinter_dims.unit: mm (height × width × depth of each splintered shard projecting above the break point)
splinter_dims.src: DESIGN — no quantitative field measurement found for war-shattered conifer splinter geometry; heights set at 21–34% of stump_shatter_h_mm for visual legibility at game scale

derivation.note: break_wood_outer bottom = stump_shatter_h_mm (650) = trunk_body top → opposite-normal contact, no z-fight; each break disc stacks on the previous one; splinter centres above break point with bases embedded ~50 mm below to read as growing from trunk
derivation.src: derived from trunk_r_mm, stump_shatter_h_mm, break_face_th_mm, splinter_dims

feature_inventory.src: DESIGN — visual grounding at soil level
conifers_org — root contact; charred per war_forests
war_forests — deep char grooves; bevelBox in cylinder flank

feature_inventory.feature: outer sapwood ring at shatter face
charred heartwood core at shatter face
feature_inventory.src: war_forests — core burned through, reads as dark bull's-eye

game_model_purpose: World scatter prop — war-shattered charred pine stump for shelled forest biomes and front-line areas in ENGENDROS PURGE
needs: Sourced stump height (mm) for a war-shattered/snapped pine — no quantified standard exists; 650 mm (dossier#stump_shatter_h_mm) is a design estimate
Sourced splinter height and angle data for war-shattered conifers — no quantitative field measurement found; dimensions in dossier#splinter_dims are design estimates
Sourced root flare radius at soil level (mm) for Pinus sylvestris — 310 mm (dossier#root_flare_r_mm) is a design estimate, not independently sourced from a forestry reference
